label_policy.caveat: Synthetic target labels are not objective ground truth and do not measure real-world hiring or assignment quality. Metrics are relative to this synthetic preference process only.

target_rules.ambiguous_competition: the target is chosen uniformly at random from the hidden top-3 qualified shortlist
target_rules.base: the target satisfies every required skill at level 2+ and has availability > 0
target_rules.hidden_labels: label profiles are generated by a separate RNG and are never written to employees.jsonl, tasks.jsonl, manifest.json or run artifacts
target_rules.high_load: the target is not one of the five permanently high-load employees
target_rules.incomplete_data: the target may have no rate or no workload records; unknown load is neutral
target_rules.no_suitable_candidate: no target is assigned; no employee has all required skills at level 2+
target_rules.no_suitable_metrics: tasks without a target are excluded from Top-1/Top-3/MRR/NDCG
target_rules.target_selection: qualified candidates are ranked only by an independent hidden synthetic label profile (preference, domain affinity, task-type affinity); the target is sampled from the hidden top-5, never from a rule score

unknown_workload_policy: neutral 0.5 scaled by present working-day share; full leave is excluded
